title: feat: wire the gh-intake data-sourcing layer into the pipeline
body: The intake layer converts raw GitHub project items into queued issues the pipeline can act on. src/orchestration/dispatch.py has a seam in load_queued_issues() where the intake binary slots in. This is connective tissue with no dependencies on other issues. Unblocks: issue #3 (going-live checklist) depends on this.

title: docs: update CLAUDE.md worker contract for the stripped-down system
body: CLAUDE.md still references removed systems. Follow-up to #2. Blocked by #2: the contract must describe the intake layer once it lands. A small docs adjustment, but a correctness fix — every Engineer session opens with CLAUDE.md.

title: feat: going-live checklist — secrets, branch protection, bootstrap
body: Blocked by #2: you cannot verify go-live readiness until the pipeline can pull its own queue via the intake layer. Depends on #2. Update the checklist to match the current system before anyone attempts go-live.

title: Assess subsystems needed for prototype
body: Map each named subsystem to its implementation and find the gaps. Depends on #2 (intake must exist to assess job issuance end to end). It is unclear which gaps remain; mostly investigate and discuss.

title: Set main as the repository default branch
body: One click in GitHub Settings. This is a human task, not autonomous pipeline work. Won't do via the pipeline — flag it for the operator to handle manually.
